title: Paul and the first-century congregation
intro: Paul’s journeys and imprisonments, the events around them, and when each of his letters was written.

items.name: First missionary tour
items.text: With Barnabas, and John Mark as far as Perga: Cyprus, Pisidian Antioch, Iconium, Lystra and Derbe, then back to Syrian Antioch.
items.sources: it “Paul”; si Study 3, chart of dates

items.name: Second missionary tour
items.text: With Silas, joined by Timothy at Lystra and Luke at Troas: into Macedonia (Philippi, Thessalonica, Beroea), then Athens and eighteen months in Corinth.
items.sources: it “Paul”; si Study 3, chart of dates

items.name: Third missionary tour
items.text: About three years in Ephesus, then Macedonia and Corinth, and back by way of Troas and Miletus toward Jerusalem.
items.sources: it “Paul”; si Study 3, chart of dates

items.name: Held at Caesarea
items.text: After his arrest Paul is kept in custody for two years under Felix, then appears before Festus and appeals to Caesar.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Voyage to Rome
items.text: Sent to Rome as a prisoner. The ship is wrecked on Malta, and he reaches Rome afterward.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: First imprisonment in Rome
items.text: Two years in his own hired house under guard, preaching to all who come to him.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Released; further travels
items.text: It appears that Nero found him innocent and released him. He visited Ephesus and Crete with Timothy and Titus, and possibly Macedonia.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Second imprisonment in Rome
items.text: In prison again at Rome, Paul writes his last letter. He likely died as a martyr under Nero shortly afterward.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Pentecost: the congregation begins
items.text: Holy spirit is poured out and the Christian congregation is formed.
items.sources: si Study 3, chart of dates

items.name: Saul is converted near Damascus
items.text: Jesus appears to Saul on the road to Damascus. Ananias restores his sight and he is baptized.
items.sources: it “Paul”
items.approx: The article gives no date for his conversion. It is placed here before his first visit to Jerusalem.

items.name: First visit to Jerusalem as a disciple
items.text: Barnabas brings him to the apostles. He meets Peter and James, then leaves by way of Caesarea for Tarsus.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Cornelius becomes a Christian
items.text: Peter visits Cornelius, the first uncircumcised Gentile to become a Christian. The seventy weeks end.
items.sources: si Study 3, chart of dates

items.name: James executed; Peter jailed
items.text: Herod Agrippa I has the apostle James put to death and imprisons Peter.
items.sources: it “Chronology”

items.name: Relief mission to Jerusalem
items.text: During the famine Paul and Barnabas carry relief from Antioch to the brothers in Judea.
items.sources: it “Paul”; it “Chronology”

items.name: Decision on circumcision
items.text: Paul and Barnabas take the question to Jerusalem. The governing body rules that Gentile Christians need not be circumcised.
items.sources: it “Paul”; si Study 3, chart of dates

items.name: Eighteen months in Corinth
items.text: Paul works with Aquila and Priscilla and is brought before the proconsul Gallio.
items.sources: it “Chronology”

items.name: About three years in Ephesus
items.text: Paul teaches in the school of Tyrannus, and the word of Jehovah spreads through the district of Asia.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Arrested in the temple
items.text: A mob seizes Paul in the temple at Jerusalem and Roman soldiers rescue him.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Shipwrecked on Malta
items.text: The ship carrying Paul to Rome is wrecked, and all on board reach land safely.
items.sources: it “Paul”

items.name: Fire of Rome
items.text: A great fire devastates Rome and Nero’s persecution of Christians follows.
items.sources: it “Chronology”

items.name: Jerusalem destroyed by the Romans
items.text: Jerusalem and its temple are destroyed, as Jesus had foretold.
items.sources: si Study 3, chart of dates
